description: This file defines the 'Model' class within the Opencart	extbackslash{}System	extbackslash{}Engine namespace. It provides a base class for models, implementing registry access via magic methods (__get, __set, __isset). The class facilitates dependency injection and registry pattern usage in the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: Base class for models in the OpenCart system, providing access to registry functionalities through magic methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Model with a Registry instance.

methods.description: Checks if a registry key exists.
